segments.en: We learned in the mishna: «At the conclusion of all blessings» recited «in the Temple,» the one reciting the blessing would say: Blessed are You Lord, God of Israel, until everlasting.

moves.summary: the mishna's clause on the Temple's concluding formula is quoted as the lemma
moves.about: the mishna's rule that all blessings in the Temple concluded 'from everlasting to everlasting' is quoted as the lemma
